استصدرن (form X)

# اُسْتُصْدِرْنَ (ustuṣdirna) /us.tusˤ.dir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
# اِسْتَصْدِرْنَ (istaṣdirna) /is.tasˤ.dir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
